subject: Follow-up: cost targets & host comparison — Skyline.ai
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Maya Reddy <maya@skyline.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-15 09:12 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + ask: cost targets & comparison vs hosts

Hi Maya — thanks again for carving out time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery call and three asks so we stay aligned:

Recap (what we heard):
- Use case: real-time clinical note summarization and search across clinician workflows (low-latency snippets + longer batch embeddings for indexing).
- Expected monthly volume: ~120M tokens in steady-state, spikes up to ~250M in peak months.
- Primary constraint: unit economics — target runway for pilot is under $X/month (Maya clarified ~$8k–15k/month during pilot).
- Security: HIPAA-sensitive, will need Private deployment evaluation if pilot expands.

Three asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the pilot monthly budget range (best guess is $8k–15k)?
2) Which functions must be realtime vs. allowed to batch (this changes cost materially)?
3) If you have vendor price cards (OpenAI/Anthropic or host invoices) you can share, that helps us align a target $/1M token we should aim for.

Attached is a lightweight comparison (redwood_1M-token-comparison.xlsx) that maps target $/1M to expected monthly spend at the volumes you shared — we used OpenAI and Anthropic public pricing as reference points. Ben and Laura are looped in for pilot economics and procurement support.

I'll follow up internally with a short proposal once you confirm the budget bracket and batching constraints.

Cheers,
Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood_1M-token-comparison.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-15 10:01 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + ask: cost targets & comparison vs hosts

Connor — good capture. A few internal notes to prep the proposal: 

- Benchmarking approach: we'll show 3 target unit tiers (conservative / target / aggressive) mapped to $/1M tokens for (a) Redwood hosted, (b) Redwood Dedicated with 90% reserved util, (c) OpenAI, (d) Anthropic, (e) two open-model hosts (ModelHostX, OpenServe). That will illustrate where we land vs their current spend.
- For Skyline volumes (120M steady), the $/1M sensitivity is large if the workload can batch embeddings off-peak. If batching only 10% of calls, cost per active token rises ~15–25%.
- Karthik: can you craft two quick config rows for pilot: (1) hosted low-latency (global), (2) dedicated single-region VPC (HIPAA) — include expected p95 latency and $/1M estimate.

Laura, can you surface typical procurement language (SOW timeline + billing cadence) we should propose for a 3-month pilot?

I'll draft the initial pricing slide and attach the pilot_pricing_draft.pdf for Connor to send once Maya confirms budget.

—Ben

From: Maya Reddy <maya@skyline.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@skyline.ai
Date: 2026-03-16 08:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + ask: cost targets & comparison vs hosts

Thanks Connor — this is helpful. Quick answers: 

- Pilot budget: we can commit to $10k–12k/month during a 3-month pilot (upper bound if performance hits our SLA).
- Batching: embeddings/indexing can be batched off-peak (estimate ~60% batchable). Real-time summarization calls must remain low-latency (can't be batched).
- Pricing references: our infra team gave a rough monthly line-item showing they're currently paying ~ $30k/month across vendors (mix of OpenAI + a smaller host). I can share an anonymized invoice snippet by EOD if that helps (procurement@ will send).

Can you put together a 1-page comparison that shows:
A) Expected pilot monthly bill at $/1M = [$15, $10, $6] for their mix of batch vs real-time (we want to see breakouts);
B) If Redwood can demonstrate $/1M <= $10, they stay in the shortlist for expansion and we can open Private deployment talks.

Appreciate the quick turn — Maya

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Maya Reddy <maya@skyline.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-16 11:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + ask: cost targets & comparison vs hosts

Perfect — thanks Maya. Plan from our side:
1) Ben & Karthik will finalize the two config rows (hosted low-latency / dedicated HIPAA) and the pilot_pricing_draft.pdf with breakouts for batch vs realtime.
2) I'll produce the single-page cost table you requested showing monthly bill at $/1M = $15, $10, $6 using your 120M steady / 60% batchable assumptions and peak sensitivity.
3) Laura will attach a 3-month pilot SOW skeleton (billing cadence and acceptance criteria) once procurement shares the anonymized invoice.

Deliverables ETA: 48 business hours (target Fri EOD 2026-03-18). If procurement sends the invoice sooner I can fold it into the table.

Thanks — we'll aim to make the $/1M <= $10 case clear.

Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: pilot_pricing_draft.pdf (proposal draft)
